# PulseCare+ Health & Emergency Platform
> PulseCare+ is a 3D spatial health and emergency response system.

- Emergency SOS: Automated simulated triage broadcast to trusted contacts.
- Medical ID: Dual-tier public triage and AES-256-GCM encrypted health vault.
- Telemetry: 3D urban hospital locator, ER wait times, and live bed tracker.
- CPR Metronome: Interactive 110 BPM audio-visual compression pulse.
